0022600128.text: Brooklyn, 0-3 and 14th in the East, visits Boston, 2-1 and second in the Atlantic, for the Nets' fourth game of the season, as they look to snap a three-game losing streak. Tyler Bilodeau is out for Brooklyn with a shoulder sprain, and Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the season series 1-3, including a 148-111 loss in Boston on February 27.
